## 5. Risk notes

1. **Functionality is the whole game**: at 73/100 self-scored, submitting
   as-is wastes the bid. Reference letters are the cheapest fix and the
   evaluation values them at 5 points each up to 25.
2. Travel between home/office and DFFE offices is "not for DFFE's account"
   — keep it inside the comprehensive VAT-inclusive offer (PRICE-VAT).
3. Deliverable timeline is tight and prescriptive (project plan in 2 weeks,
   inception report in 1 month, print 600 copies) — mirror the ToR's
   numbering in the methodology exactly.
4. Master-document + USB + TOC screening is an administrative kill unique
   to this buyer — assign an owner.
